summary: Emely replied to Message 1 asking what the FitXpress process entails, since her clinic currently has to schedule a separate medical assistant appointment afterward for patients to complete measurements and InBody scale readings.
extracted_action: Wants to know whether FitXpress replaces the follow-up MA appointment and InBody scale step: who completes the scan, when (before/during the visit), and what she gets back (measurements only, or body composition too) vs. the InBody.
suggested_reply_draft: Hi Emely, good question. The patient completes the scan themselves, two photos in the practice's app, so there is no separate MA appointment to schedule for it. It can be done before the visit at home or on a tablet in the waiting room, takes under a minute, and returns 80+ body measurements plus body composition estimates right away, no InBody hardware or extra staff time needed. Happy to walk through how that would sit alongside your current InBody workflow if useful, 15 min: https://meetings.hubspot.com/nick-omelchak
